basic.name: Noxious Blossom
basic.description: After 0.5 seconds, cause an area to explode with pollen dealing 160~~0.04~~ damage.

basic.name: Crippling Spores
basic.description: Enemies currently afflicted by Nature's Toxin have its duration increased by 3 seconds and are Slowed by 40%, decaying over 3 seconds.

basic.name: Wisp
basic.description: Spawn a Wisp to scout an area. Can be redirected once active. When the Wisp is in a bush for more 2 seconds, its vision radius is increased by 75%. Lasts 45 seconds.

basic.name: Relocate Wisp
basic.description: Moves the Wisp to a new location.

heroic.name: Thornwood Vine
heroic.description:
Send forth vines that deal 184~~0.04~~ damage to all enemies in a line.

Stores up to 3 charges.

heroic.name: Leaping Strike
heroic.description:
Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271~~0.04~~ damage.

Stores up to 2 charges.

trait.name: Nature's Toxin
trait.description: Lunara's Basic Attacks and damaging Abilities poison their target, dealing 33~~0.04~~ damage a second for 3 seconds. Every additional application increases the duration by 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 9 seconds.

mount.name: Dryad's Swiftness
mount.description: Lunara moves 20% faster by leaping short distances.

mount.name: Dryad's Swiftness
mount.description: Lunara moves 20% faster by leaping short distances.

activable.name: Greater Spell Shield - Disabled
activable.description:
Greater Spell Shield is disabled and will not trigger.

Click this button to enable Greater Spell Shield.

activable.name: Abolish Magic
activable.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

level1.name: Sentinel Wisp
level1.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

level1.name: Natural Perspective
level1.description: Nature's Toxin reveals enemies for its duration.

level1.name: Hippity Hop
level1.description: After not Basic Attacking or taking damage for 2 seconds, increase the Move Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness by 10%.

level4.name: Blossom Swell
level4.description: Increases Noxious Blossom's cast range by 25%. and its radius by 20%. Blossom Swell applies 1 additional stack of Nature's Toxin to enemies hit.

level4.name: Nature's Culling
level4.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

level4.name: Siphoning Toxin
level4.description: While at least one enemy is afflicted by Nature's Toxin, heal for 9~~0.04~~ per second. When an enemy Hero has 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin, increase this healing by 19~~0.04~~ per second.

level7.name: Splintered Spear
level7.description:
Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.

Splintered Spear deals 90~~0.04~~ damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

level7.name: Choking Pollen
level7.description: Noxious Blossom deals 100% more damage to enemies afflicted by Nature's Toxin, increased to 175% against enemies with 3 stacks.

level7.name: Wild Vigor
level7.description: Using Crippling Spores increases the damage of Lunara's next 4 Basic Attacks by 70%.

level10.name: Thornwood Vine
level10.description:
Send forth vines that deal 184~~0.04~~ damage to all enemies in a line.

Stores up to 3 charges.

level10.name: Leaping Strike
level10.description:
Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271~~0.04~~ damage.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level13.name: Endless Spores
level13.description: Casting Crippling Spores while at least 2 Heroes are afflicted by Nature's Toxin reduces the cooldown by 4 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

level13.name: Let Them Wither
level13.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

level13.name: Greater Spell Shield
level13.description:
Every 30 seconds, gain 75 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level13.name: Abolish Magic
level13.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

level16.name: Accelerated Contamination
level16.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Noxious Blossom from 60 to 40. While at least 1 enemy Hero is afflicted with Nature's Toxin, Noxious Blossom's cooldown recharges 75% faster.

level16.name: Star Wood Spear
level16.description: Increase Lunara's Basic Attack range by 0.5. Using Crippling Spores increases Lunara's Basic Attack range by an additional 2.25 for 6 seconds.

level16.name: Invigorating Spores
level16.description: Crippling Spores grants 30% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin deal damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

level16.name: Unfair Advantage
level16.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level20.name: For the Wildlands
level20.description: Thornwood Vine shoots 4 additional vines in an arc.

level20.name: Boundless Stride
level20.description: All Leaping Strike charges are returned every 15 seconds. Leaping Strike can be used on allies.

level20.name: Forest's Wrath
level20.description:
Lunara's Heroic Ability applies 1 additional stack of Nature's Toxin to enemies, and its range is increased by 30%.

Passive: Increase Lunara's vision radius by 35%.

level20.name: Intensifying Toxin
level20.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

level20.name: Galloping Gait
level20.description: Activate to increase the Movement Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness to 80% for 6 seconds.
